rationale: The candidate is suitable for packaging. (1) Public contract vs source: I verified the base question's pipeline description against installed matchms 0.30.2 source — normalize_intensities divides by max intensity (normalize_intensities.py:35-44); select_by_intensity keeps intensity_from <= x (select_by_intensity.py:37, inclusive, matching "≥ 0.01"); select_by_mz keeps mz_from <= mz <= mz_to (select_by_mz.py:35, inclusive both ends); add_precursor_mz falls back to PEPMASS (add_precursor_mz.py:72-74); the cosine kernels match at |Δm/z| ≤ tolerance (spectrum_similarity_functions.py:76-85), apply greedy one-use-per-peak assignment after sorting by descending intensity product (ModifiedCosine.py:126-128, spectrum_similarity_functions.py:100-104), and normalize by sqrt of summed squared intensities (:107-110); ModifiedCosine pools unshifted and precursor-difference-shifted candidates (ModifiedCosine.py:108-125). The question's claims about 1267 spectra, unclamped self-match scores (recorded 1.000000000000003) and identifier recovery via the metadata chain are corroborated by the trial log and recorded reference observations. (2) Comparisons: the grader compares parsed CSV values (never bytes), keyed by stable identities (spectrum_index / matched_spectrum_index), with cross-file consistency against the submission's own identifiers table, exact index-set equality, exact integer counts, and a 1e-12 absolute score tolerance justified by serialization/summation-order effects and probed from above (1e-6 and 5e-12 perturbations rejected in executed probes). The duplicate-group repositioning allowance is effectively vacuous (identical-identifier swaps are value no-ops), accepting no wrong answer. (3) Controls: 20/20 executed controls met expected outcomes — reference/recomputed/alternative passes, empty/misplaced fails, per-file missing-output fails, 8 wrong_solution probes with meaningful scientific errors and 1 valid representation alternative (17-digit scientific notation + LF) accepted. (4) Answer isolation: the solver receives only the MGF (sha-verified b7d33f02...); the reference inventory is exactly the six declared files; the oracle isolation run and the independent solution executed without answer access and produced byte-identical outputs; the dependency-asset catalog enumerated 10,758 installed files across 42 distributions, content-inspected the four matchms data tables (adduct/key lookups), found no 'GNPS-NIH' content, and the asset-value-hint numeric-literal scan returned zero findings against all reference cells. (5) Source coverage: all six per-query analytical branches are required outputs; the tables not surviving trial serialization were recovered source-faithfully under the endpoint-recovery policy and cross-checked value-wise against the surviving recorded artifacts (identifiers CSV, best_matches_spectrum_97.csv, all-pairs npz at both orientations); excluded branches (histograms, heatmaps, RDKit drawings, np.where case selection, json/pickle serialization of the intermediate) have source-backed non-scientific roles. Residual, honestly disclosed limitations (cross-stack determinism of the tolerance; no real ties in current data) do not undermine the current evidence.
